capabilities: Sync Confluence pages to vault folders via configurable CQL profiles
Fetch individual pages by URL, optionally including child pages
Convert Confluence Storage Format markup to Markdown
Download attached images and generate frontmatter from page metadata
Preserve user-written notes below a section marker across syncs
extras: Listing is flagged as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a Korean README (README.ko.md) is available, and the plugin also ships in Japanese and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Confluence pages into the vault as Markdown, so teams maintaining documentation in Confluence must copy content manually.

relations.evidence: Sync Confluence pages into your Obsidian Vault as Markdown files.
If you also use Jira Weaver, run the command Link Confluence Pages in Jira Notes after syncing.

requires.name: Confluence API token (Cloud) or Personal Access Token (Data Center/Server)

summary: Confluence integration that syncs Confluence pages into the vault as Markdown with incremental sync, frontmatter, image downloads, and CQL-based profiles.
